description: PROVISIONAL. Means and sample SDs of the five readability features over 772 windows of research-article body text: the opening ~150 words (whole sentences) of up to 4 body sections per article, from the first 100 training-split articles of each of BioLaySumm/BioLaySumm2025-eLife, BioLaySumm/BioLaySumm2025-PLOS (PLOS and eLife articles, CC BY 4.0). spaCy en_core_web_sm-3.8.0, wordfreq 3.1.1.
